snippet.title: Force Typhoon - Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
#ForceTyphoon on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4528930/Force_Typhoon/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=announcetrailer&utm_campaign=announce

Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this gritty and atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D.
Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash the might of your firepower against the enemy and break the blockade forced upon your world.

Inspired by the classics of the 80s and 90s, Force Typhoon features pure arcade adrenaline, precise controls, immersive 3D visuals and a strong atmospheric edge - With an oppressive foe that grants minimal downtime between waves.

#shootemup  #shmup #indiegame #steam
